waypoints.name: Hannegan Pass Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Bellingham, take SR-542 (Mount Baker Highway) east through Glacier. About 12.5 miles east of the Glacier Public Service Center, turn left onto Hannegan Pass Road (FS Road 32) and follow it about 5.3 miles to the trailhead at the road end. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park, and overnight camping inside North Cascades National Park requires a backcountry permit.
